+"""Jobs-to-be-Done CLI subcommands."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import typer
+
+from cli.backend import Backend
+
+jobs_app = typer.Typer(help="Manage Jobs-to-be-Done.")
+
+
+def _backend(ctx: typer.Context) -> Backend:
+    backend: Backend | None = ctx.obj
+    if backend is None:
+        typer.echo("Error: no backend configured", err=True)
+        raise typer.Exit(code=1)
+    return backend
+
+
+@jobs_app.command("add")
+def add(
+    ctx: typer.Context,
+    name: str = typer.Option(..., help="Job name"),
+    description: str | None = typer.Option(default=None, help="Job description"),
+) -> None:
+    """Add a new Job."""
+    args: dict[str, Any] = {"name": name}
+    if description is not None:
+        args["description"] = description
+    typer.echo(_backend(ctx).call("add_job", args))
+
+
+@jobs_app.command("list")
+def list_jobs(ctx: typer.Context) -> None:
+    """List all Jobs."""
+    typer.echo(_backend(ctx).call("get_jobs", {}))
+
+
+@jobs_app.command("get")
+def get(ctx: typer.Context, job_id: str = typer.Argument(..., help="Job ID")) -> None:
+    """Get a Job by ID."""
+    typer.echo(_backend(ctx).call("get_job", {"job_id": job_id}))
+
+
+@jobs_app.command("update")
+def update(
+    ctx: typer.Context,
+    job_id: str = typer.Argument(..., help="Job ID"),
+    name: str | None = typer.Option(default=None, help="New job name"),
+    description: str | None = typer.Option(default=None, help="New job description"),
+) -> None:
+    """Update an existing Job."""
+    args: dict[str, Any] = {"job_id": job_id}
+    if name is not None:
+        args["name"] = name
+    if description is not None:
+        args["description"] = description
+    typer.echo(_backend(ctx).call("update_job", args))
+
+
+@jobs_app.command("delete")
+def delete(
+    ctx: typer.Context,
+    job_id: str = typer.Argument(..., help="Job ID"),
+    yes: bool = typer.Option(False, "--yes", "-y", help="Skip confirmation"),
+) -> None:
+    """Delete a Job."""
+    if not yes:
+        confirm = typer.confirm(f"Delete job {job_id}?")
+        if not confirm:
+            raise typer.Exit()
+    typer.echo(_backend(ctx).call("delete_job", {"job_id": job_id}))

+"""Tests for the Jobs CLI command group."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+
+from typer.testing import CliRunner
+
+from cli.cli import app
+
+
+def test_jobs_add_list_get_round_trip(tmp_path):
+    db = str(tmp_path / "odi.db")
+    runner = CliRunner()
+    add = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "add", "--name", "Onboard"])
+    assert add.exit_code == 0 and "created successfully" in add.output
+    listed = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"])
+    assert "Onboard" in listed.output
+
+
+def test_jobs_get_unknown_reports_error(tmp_path):
+    result = CliRunner().invoke(app, ["--db", str(tmp_path / "odi.db"), "jobs", "get", "nope"])
+    assert result.exit_code == 0 and "not found" in result.output.lower()
+
+
+def _only_job_id(listed_output: str) -> str:
+    jobs = json.loads(listed_output)
+    assert len(jobs) == 1
+    return jobs[0]["id"]
+
+
+def test_jobs_get_returns_full_job(tmp_path):
+    db = str(tmp_path / "odi.db")
+    runner = CliRunner()
+    runner.invoke(
+        app,
+        ["--db", db, "jobs", "add", "--name", "Write docs", "--description", "draft"],
+    )
+    job_id = _only_job_id(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output)
+
+    fetched = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "get", job_id])
+
+    assert fetched.exit_code == 0
+    payload = json.loads(fetched.output)
+    assert payload["name"] == "Write docs"
+    assert payload["description"] == "draft"
+
+
+def test_jobs_update_only_changes_provided_options(tmp_path):
+    db = str(tmp_path / "odi.db")
+    runner = CliRunner()
+    runner.invoke(
+        app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "add", "--name", "Old name", "--description", "keep me"]
+    )
+    job_id = _only_job_id(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output)
+
+    renamed = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "update", job_id, "--name", "New name"])
+    assert renamed.exit_code == 0 and "updated successfully" in renamed.output
+    after = json.loads(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "get", job_id]).output)
+    assert after["name"] == "New name"
+    assert after["description"] == "keep me"
+
+    redescribed = runner.invoke(
+        app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "update", job_id, "--description", "new desc"]
+    )
+    assert redescribed.exit_code == 0
+    after = json.loads(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "get", job_id]).output)
+    assert after["name"] == "New name"
+    assert after["description"] == "new desc"
+
+
+def test_jobs_update_unknown_reports_error(tmp_path):
+    result = CliRunner().invoke(
+        app, ["--db", str(tmp_path / "odi.db"), "jobs", "update", "nope", "--name", "X"]
+    )
+    assert result.exit_code == 0 and "not found" in result.output.lower()
+
+
+def test_jobs_delete_prompts_then_removes(tmp_path):
+    db = str(tmp_path / "odi.db")
+    runner = CliRunner()
+    runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "add", "--name", "Temp"])
+    job_id = _only_job_id(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output)
+
+    declined = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "delete", job_id], input="n\n")
+    assert declined.exit_code == 0
+    assert json.loads(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output) != []
+
+    confirmed = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "delete", job_id], input="y\n")
+    assert confirmed.exit_code == 0 and "deleted successfully" in confirmed.output
+    assert json.loads(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output) == []
+
+
+def test_jobs_delete_yes_skips_prompt(tmp_path):
+    db = str(tmp_path / "odi.db")
+    runner = CliRunner()
+    runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "add", "--name", "Temp"])
+    job_id = _only_job_id(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output)
+
+    result = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "delete", job_id, "-y"])
+
+    assert result.exit_code == 0 and "deleted successfully" in result.output
+    assert "y/N" not in result.output
+    assert json.loads(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output) == []
+
+
+def test_jobs_delete_unknown_reports_error(tmp_path):
+    result = CliRunner().invoke(
+        app, ["--db", str(tmp_path / "odi.db"), "jobs", "delete", "nope", "-y"]
+    )
+    assert result.exit_code == 0 and "not found" in result.output.lower()
+
+
+def test_unknown_backend_reports_clear_error():
+    result = CliRunner().invoke(app, ["--backend", "nope", "jobs", "list"])
+
+    assert result.exit_code != 0
+    assert "Unknown backend" in result.output
+    assert "Traceback" not in result.output
+
+
+def test_db_with_mcp_backend_warns(tmp_path):
+    result = CliRunner().invoke(
+        app, ["--backend", "mcp", "--db", str(tmp_path / "odi.db"), "jobs", "--help"]
+    )
+
+    assert result.exit_code == 0
+    assert "ignored" in result.stderr.lower()

"""Tests for the Jobs CLI command group."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json

from typer.testing import CliRunner

from cli.cli import app


def test_jobs_add_list_get_round_trip(tmp_path):
    db = str(tmp_path / "odi.db")
    runner = CliRunner()
    add = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "add", "--name", "Onboard"])
    assert add.exit_code == 0 and "created successfully" in add.output
    listed = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"])
    assert "Onboard" in listed.output


def test_jobs_get_unknown_reports_error(tmp_path):
    result = CliRunner().invoke(
        app, ["--db", str(tmp_path / "odi.db"), "jobs", "get", "nope"]
    )
    assert result.exit_code == 0 and "not found" in result.output.lower()


def _only_job_id(listed_output: str) -> str:
    jobs = json.loads(listed_output)
    assert len(jobs) == 1
    return jobs[0]["id"]


def test_jobs_get_returns_full_job(tmp_path):
    db = str(tmp_path / "odi.db")
    runner = CliRunner()
    runner.invoke(
        app,
        ["--db", db, "jobs", "add", "--name", "Write docs", "--description", "draft"],
    )
    job_id = _only_job_id(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output)

    fetched = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "get", job_id])

    assert fetched.exit_code == 0
    payload = json.loads(fetched.output)
    assert payload["name"] == "Write docs"
    assert payload["description"] == "draft"


def test_jobs_update_only_changes_provided_options(tmp_path):
    db = str(tmp_path / "odi.db")
    runner = CliRunner()
    runner.invoke(
        app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "add", "--name", "Old name", "--description", "keep me"]
    )
    job_id = _only_job_id(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output)

    renamed = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "update", job_id, "--name", "New name"])
    assert renamed.exit_code == 0 and "updated successfully" in renamed.output
    after = json.loads(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "get", job_id]).output)
    assert after["name"] == "New name"
    assert after["description"] == "keep me"

    redescribed = runner.invoke(
        app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "update", job_id, "--description", "new desc"]
    )
    assert redescribed.exit_code == 0
    after = json.loads(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "get", job_id]).output)
    assert after["name"] == "New name"
    assert after["description"] == "new desc"


def test_jobs_update_unknown_reports_error(tmp_path):
    result = CliRunner().invoke(
        app, ["--db", str(tmp_path / "odi.db"), "jobs", "update", "nope", "--name", "X"]
    )
    assert result.exit_code == 0 and "not found" in result.output.lower()


def test_jobs_delete_prompts_then_removes(tmp_path):
    db = str(tmp_path / "odi.db")
    runner = CliRunner()
    runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "add", "--name", "Temp"])
    job_id = _only_job_id(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output)

    declined = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "delete", job_id], input="n\n")
    assert declined.exit_code == 0
    assert json.loads(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output) != []

    confirmed = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "delete", job_id], input="y\n")
    assert confirmed.exit_code == 0 and "deleted successfully" in confirmed.output
    assert json.loads(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output) == []


def test_jobs_delete_yes_skips_prompt(tmp_path):
    db = str(tmp_path / "odi.db")
    runner = CliRunner()
    runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "add", "--name", "Temp"])
    job_id = _only_job_id(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output)

    result = runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "delete", job_id, "-y"])

    assert result.exit_code == 0 and "deleted successfully" in result.output
    assert "y/N" not in result.output
    assert json.loads(runner.invoke(app, ["--db", db, "jobs", "list"]).output) == []


def test_jobs_delete_unknown_reports_error(tmp_path):
    result = CliRunner().invoke(
        app, ["--db", str(tmp_path / "odi.db"), "jobs", "delete", "nope", "-y"]
    )
    assert result.exit_code == 0 and "not found" in result.output.lower()


def test_unknown_backend_reports_clear_error():
    result = CliRunner().invoke(app, ["--backend", "nope", "jobs", "list"])

    assert result.exit_code != 0
    assert "Unknown backend" in result.output
    assert "Traceback" not in result.output


def test_db_with_mcp_backend_warns(tmp_path):
    result = CliRunner().invoke(
        app, ["--backend", "mcp", "--db", str(tmp_path / "odi.db"), "jobs", "--help"]
    )

    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert "ignored" in result.stderr.lower()
